sections.title: Matchup Summary
sections.body: This matchup features Power fastball-slider starter against Command-oriented sinker-changeup starter. The scouting note is matchup fit, with each pressure point shaping what to watch.

sections.title: Demo Pitcher A vs San Francisco Giants
sections.body: Demo Pitcher A's four-seam-slider combination gives him above-average swing-and-miss. This lineup is roughly average against RHP pitching (.721 OPS), with no glaring weakness to attack.

sections.title: Demo Pitcher B vs Los Angeles Dodgers
sections.body: Demo Pitcher B needs to keep the command edge visible and use the changeup to manage contact. This lineup hits well against LHP pitching (.768 OPS), so Demo Pitcher B cannot live over the middle. They draw walks at an above-average rate, so Demo Pitcher B needs efficient strikes.

away_starter.grade_explanation: A Game Score of 35 reflects a rough outing - the hits and walks piled up and shortened his night.
away_starter.plan_vs_execution: The plan was to use the four-seam fastball to reach curveball counts, but 4 walks kept him from controlling the sequence.
away_starter.what_to_watch_next: The next checkpoint is tightening strike-zone control before traffic builds.

home_starter.name: Demo Pitcher D
home_starter.grade_explanation: A Game Score of 61 reflects a solid, above-average start - he worked deep, limited walks, and kept the damage in check.
home_starter.plan_vs_execution: The plan was to command the cutter and finish with the changeup; 1 walk and 2 earned runs show the execution mostly matched it.
home_starter.what_to_watch_next: The next checkpoint is repeating that walk suppression deep into another start.
